future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Federated Learning Framework for Cross-Device Keystroke Biometrics
future_contributions.technical_approach: Develop a federated learning architecture that trains device-agnostic keystroke models across distributed user devices without centralized data aggregation. Incorporate device-specific normalization layers to account for hardware variations.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables scalable, privacy-preserving authentication across heterogeneous devices while maintaining accuracy, addressing the degradation observed in centralized systems with large user counts.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Leverages existing federated learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow Federated) and device-specific preprocessing techniques, with potential for integration with cloud-edge computing architectures.

future_contributions.gap: Adaptive question generation for real-time lie detection
future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Context-Aware Question Generation with Reinforcement Learning
future_contributions.technical_approach: Implement a neural network that dynamically generates emotionally salient questions based on conversational context, using reinforcement learning to optimize question relevance and deception detection efficacy in real-time.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enhances covert lie detection in unscripted environments by adapting to conversational flow, overcoming the limitations of static question sets.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Builds on transformer-based question generation models with RL reward functions derived from keystroke deviation metrics, feasible with existing NLP and RL toolkits.

future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Domain-Adaptive Emotion Recognition with Multi-Modal Transfer Learning
future_contributions.technical_approach: Train a domain-invariant emotion recognition model using pre-trained multi-modal (text+keystroke) representations, then fine-tune with minimal real-world data through adversarial domain adaptation to reduce distribution shift.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Significantly improves emotion recognition accuracy in uncontrolled environments by mitigating controlled experiment biases.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Utilizes existing multi-modal pre-training frameworks (e.g., CLIP) with domain adaptation techniques, requiring only small real-world datasets for fine-tuning.

future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Personalized Emotional State Estimation via Hybrid Biometric Fusion
future_contributions.technical_approach: Combine keystroke dynamics with physiological signals (e.g., GSR) using a dual-branch neural network, with a personalization module that learns user-specific baseline patterns to isolate emotional deviations.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enhances emotion detection accuracy by explicitly modeling individual typing baselines, addressing the dominance of individual variability over emotional effects.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Feasible with wearable sensors and existing neural network architectures for multimodal fusion, requiring minimal additional hardware.

future_contributions.proposed_contribution: Differentially Private Federated Mood Detection with Edge Computing
future_contributions.technical_approach: Design a privacy-preserving system where mood inference occurs on-device using edge computing, with differential privacy mechanisms applied to model updates shared across devices.
future_contributions.expected_impact: Enables continuous mental health monitoring without exposing sensitive keystroke data, overcoming privacy constraints in clinical settings.
future_contributions.implementation_feasibility: Leverages edge AI hardware and DP-SGD techniques, compatible with existing mobile device architectures and federated learning protocols.
